Discord • Documentation

**PannHarvestEngine** is a high-performance, modular resource gathering framework for Minecraft. It replaces vanilla mining and interaction mechanics with a versatile **HP-based** harvesting system suitable for ores, timber, and custom agriculture. Featuring per-tool damage scaling, **multi-file configuration**, and a "packet-based" visual interface, it provides a seamless RPG-style experience with smooth progress bars and custom loot tables—all without interfering with vanilla block physics until the harvest is complete. **Full ItemsAdder support included! The plugin is designed to work perfectly standalone, but automatically integrates with ItemsAdder if installed.** ---- ### ✏️ Fully customizable - Set the number of clicks for vanilla blocks and custom blocks using ItemsAdder - Adjust the force of your tools, vanilla and custom - Customize technical settings such as cooldowns, sounds, the progress bar, and much more! ---- ### 🧰 Compatibility **Works with vanilla blocks and tools, but you can also use custom resources with ItemsAdder.** | Platform | Status | Version | | :--- | :---: | :---: | | **Paper** | ✅ Supported | 1.21+ | | **Purpur** | ➖ Not Tested | 1.21+ | | **Spigot** | ❌ Not Supported | — | > **Note:** Purpur is fully supported as it is a high-performance fork of Paper.
